items.title: Jasper Taylor Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: Trevor Compton was telling me about the E-Light number one, number two, and the Deluxe, and Dreamland were all along there.

ctx.x: Asia. Asia. Chinese restaurant. And I met Freddie there. And then, at that time you had, that was a stroll, we had the stroll, and there was a place of entertainment, two and three in a block. And you just walked from 31st to 35th, and you go in mostly the, any of the places of entertainment, they had a band there.
Trevor Compton was telling me about the E-Light number one, number two, and the Deluxe, and Dreamland were all along there. Yeah. Did you play those places too, or mostly just the theaters? Theaters.
Theaters. Mm-hmm. And after, after our places I also would play there. Yeah.
